findings.evidence: P&L row 7 is gross profit and the cost-of-sales row (row 6) is already negative. Every other monthly gross-profit formula, including I7 and K7, adds the negative cost of sales (for example, =I5+I6 and =K5+K6). J7 instead subtracts J6, turning the negative cost into an addition. J6 is -193,066, so correcting the sign reduces J7, J15, and total EBITDA AA15 by 2 x 193,066 = 386,132. Valuation!B7 is unaffected because its EBITDA input sums months O:Z, which excludes month J.
